verdict.rationale: Logseq stores data as local Markdown/EDN files by default with no cloud requirement, and is documented as 'privacy-first' — users confirm they run it fully local or pair it with self-managed sync like GitHub instead of vendor cloud. The official Logseq Sync exists only as an optional paid vendor-hosted add-on, not a self-hosted backend, and one user explicitly notes there's no built-in way to self-host it as a server despite an open feature request. missing for 10: an officially supported self-hosted sync backend (only vendor-cloud Sync or DIY git workflows exist), and independent verification that local mode has no offline degradation.
